value.text:
札幌ファッションデザイン専門学校DOREME is a vocational school in Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan, operated by 学校法人浅井学園. It is located in the Northern Regions Academic Information Center PORTO. Founded by 浅井淑子 in September 1939 as 北海ドレスメーカー女学園, the school initially offered regular and evening courses. It underwent several name changes, including to 北海道ドレスメーカー学院 in 1975. In 1976 the school was reorganized as a vocational school offering specialized courses. It moved to PORTO in 2013 and adopted its present name in 2021.

The school focuses on fashion education. The available description lists a two-year comprehensive fashion department with design, technique and business courses, a one-year evening course and a one-year advanced course. The chronology, however, records that the evening course changed from one year to two years in April 2015; the course list is undated, so the discrepancy cannot be resolved from the supplied evidence. The article also records an educational philosophy of 愛と知 (love and knowledge).
